name: Groundedness (typed)
description: Whether the answer rests on the context the agent retrieved, rather than on what it made up.

questions.name: grounded
questions.instructions: Is every claim in the answer supported by the retrieved context?
questions.yes_means: every claim is in the context
questions.no_means: a claim is not in the context, or contradicts it

questions.name: support
questions.instructions: How much of the answer does the retrieved context support?

options.name: partial
options.means: some of it, the rest unsupported

options.name: none
options.means: none of it, or the context holds nothing relevant
